catalog.name: Tiny Platformer Party
catalog.blurb: Race the pack for gold and stomp monsters on one tiny level.

landing.pitch: Race the pack for gold and stomp the monsters, all on one tiny level.
landing.about: Jake Gordon's javascript-tiny-platformer as a party race for up to eight on the same level. Gold is a point and a stomped monster is a point. Touch a monster from the side and you are back at a spawn point, blinking and safe, never out. Your camera follows you; the big screen shows the whole map.

controls.phone: Stick under your left thumb, JUMP at the right edge (or tap)
controls.computer: Left and Right (or A and D) to run; Space, Up or W to jump
controls.tv: The big screen shows the whole map with a name on every runner.

how: Run and jump through the level.
Gold is a point, and it comes back ten seconds after someone takes it.
Land on a monster to stomp it for a point; touch one from the side and you respawn.
Most points when the clock runs out wins.

hero.alt: Bots race along the red platforms for gold on the big screen

landing.headline: Gold, stomps and two minutes.
